name: HC15: Lost to follow-up
description: Number of ART clients lost to follow-up during the reporting period
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f
configJson: {"version": 1, "themeUuid": "fce3f3a0-826f-11f1-b08c-f4053e2709b9", "conditions": [], "sqlPreview": "SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id AS patient_id, p.gender, p.birthdate FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s INNER JOIN person p ON s.client_id = p.person_id WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NOT NULL AND s.lost_to_followup = 'Yes' AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate", "themeConfig": {"fields": [{"key": "client", "expr": "client_id", "type": "number", "label": "Client"}, {"key": "gender", "expr": "gender", "type": "coded", "label": "Gender"}, {"key": "lost_to_followup", "expr": "lost_to_followup", "type": "coded", "label": "Lost to Follow-up"}], "conditions": [{"key": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "label": "Baseline Regimen Start Date", "column": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "handler": "DATE_RANGE", "operator": "BETWEEN", "valueType": "date"}, {"key": "lost_to_followup", "label": "Lost to Follow-up", "column": "lost_to_followup", "handler": "TEXT", "operator": "=", "valueType": "coded"}], "dateColumn": "baseline_regimen_start_date", "sourceTable": "mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary", "patientIdColumn": "client_id"}}
sqlTemplate:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date IS NOT NULL
  AND s.lost_to_followup = 'Yes'
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate 
  AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate
